description:
GPT Image 2 just dropped and it's already #1 on the LMArena leaderboard but is it actually the best model for AI UGC? I put it head-to-head against Nano Banana 2 and Nano Banana Pro across 7 different tests to find out which one creators should actually be using.

I also break down the three quality tiers of GPT Image 2 (low / mid / high) and which one is actually worth the credits.
If you're running AI UGC campaigns, building AI influencers, or making content for brand clients, this video tells you exactly which model to use for which scenario and which one to skip.
